jobs.description:
Job Description

About the role

Nexperia is a global leader in essential semiconductors, enabling a sustainable future through innovation in automotive, industrial, mobile and consumer applications. As we continue to expand our Silicon Carbide (SiC) portfolio, we are looking for an experienced (Sr) Product Marketing Manager (m/f/d) to drive business growth, product strategy and market success across our SiC product portfolio.

This is a highly visible, international role where you will shape the future direction of our SiC business, working closely with R&D, operations, sales, quality and marketing teams to deliver innovative products and profitable growth

What you will do

- Own and manage the SiC product portfolio throughout the entire product lifecycle, including product positioning, specification definition, quality requirements and pricing strategy.
- Define and drive the SiC product roadmap, identifying opportunities for innovation, optimisation and business growth.
- Develop and execute the global SiC product strategy and long-term portfolio planning.
- Deliver annual revenue and margin targets by driving cross-functional initiatives and ensuring successful execution of business plans.
- Lead New Product Introduction (NPI) activities to achieve business case objectives and accelerate market adoption.
- Own business case development, execution and fulfilment throughout the product lifecycle.
- Conduct market intelligence activities, including competitor benchmarking, technology trend monitoring and application analysis.
- Act as the key interface between product marketing, development, operations, quality, sales and other Business Group stakeholders.
- Support customer engagement activities and translate market requirements into actionable product strategies

What you will need

- Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Semiconductor Physics or a related technical discipline.
- At least 7 years of experience in product marketing, product management or a similar commercial semiconductor role.
- Strong knowledge of power semiconductors, with experience in SiC, power electronics or related applications being highly desirable.
- Understanding of electronic hardware systems and customer application requirements.
- Demonstrated ability to develop business cases and drive product portfolio growth.
- Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication, influencing and presentation skills.
- Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong customer focus and commercial awareness.
- Experience leading cross-functional projects and influencing stakeholders in a matrix organisation.
- Ability to work effectively across international and multicultural teams.
- Fluent English language skills, both written and spoken.
- Willingness to travel internationally (approximately 10–15%).

jobs.occupation: Finance Manager Europe / Head of Finance (m/f/x), Hamburg (Fachagrarwirt/in - Head-Greenkeeper/in)

CPA/ACCA or comparable qualification is a plus Experiences in FP&A Self starter, making impact person Experienced in finance process improvement, digitalization, and automation Excellent communication skills in English and German (business fluent) Experience in group accounting and consolidation Ability to direct the group accounting and consolidation team, ideally in an international environment Month-end closing and financial reporting skills Practical experience in audit management and preparation of statutory financial statements (HGB; IFRS exposure is an advantage) Sound knowledge of SAP (FI, SD, MM)  Willingness to travel to Hamburg approximately once per month (travel expenses covered) Our offer A key leadership role with real impact on the company's international finance setup The opportunity to drive digital transformation within a growing global business Flexible hybrid working model (remote from Germany with regular visits to Hamburg) A collaborative, international work environment with short decision paths Discounted cruises for you, your family and your friends as well as other travel benefits Employee discounts through cooperation partners such as Bäderland or Corporate Benefits Contribution to the company pension scheme Regular team events and company celebrations Complete hardware package that we deliver to your home

jobs.occupation: Principal Product Application Engineer (m/f/d) - SiC (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
About the role

As a Principal Product Application Engineer (m/f/d), you will work on developing and validating advanced SiC-based solutions, turning cutting-edge semiconductor technology into real-world applications. You will collaborate with global teams, support customers, and help drive new products to market, combining hands-on engineering with strong application insight.

What you will do

- Design power electronics platforms using SiC technologies
- Run and analyze testing and validation of power systems
- Build demo systems and present solutions to customers
- Support product go-to-market and customer design-in activities
- Create and deliver technical presentations, training, and webinars
- Help shape next-generation semiconductor performance through application insights
- Support device testing, characterization, and modelling
- Collaborate with internal teams, partners, and universities
- Work in a global, multicultural team

What you will bring

- M.Sc. Degree or higher in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or similar
- 5+ years in the semiconductor industry (power applications focus; WBG preferred)
- Strong experience in hardware design for SiC, GaN, and IGBT applications
- Knowledge of thermal/mechanical design, gate driving, and inductance optimization
- Skilled in measurements, testing, and high-voltage lab environments
- Solid experience with PCB design, simulation, and power module design
- Able to connect device physics, converter design, and customer needs
- Good communication skills; fluent in English (German is a plus)
- Hands-on approach and willingness to travel occasionally

jobs.occupation: (Sr.) Product Manager (m/f/d) – ESD Protection & Filtering (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
About the job

As a Product Manager, you will own and drive the success of a defined product portfolio, combining strategic thinking with strong market and customer focus. Positioned between Regional Marketing and Product Group Leadership, you will translate market insights, customer needs, and business strategy into actionable product decisions. You will work closely with cross-functional teams - including R&D, Marketing, Sales, and Operations - to ensure that products are competitively positioned, financially successful, and aligned with long-term portfolio objectives.

What you will do

- Portfolio owner for automotive ESD/TVS and PowerTVS within the Product Group Protection & Filtering
- Define and execute product strategies across the full product lifecycle (from ideation to end-of-life) while monitoring product performance and support delivery of revenue and profitability targets
- Analyze markets, applications, customer needs, and competitors to identify growth opportunities
- Develop and maintain product roadmaps aligned with portfolio and business goals
- Build, evaluate, and drive business cases for new product opportunities including business case fulfillment
- Collaborate with R&D, Marketing, Sales, and Operations to ensure aligned execution
- Support New Product Introduction (NPI) with clear value propositions and go-to-market plans
- Drive product positioning, pricing, and portfolio optimization
- Contribute to marketing content and product communication materials

What you will need

- Minimum master’s degree in industrial engineering, electrical engineering or semiconductor device physics
- Minimum 5 years of experience in product management, product marketing, sales or business development (ideally in semiconductor or high-tech domain)
- Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills
- Ability to translate technical and market insights into actionable strategies
- Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder (internal/external) management skills
- Experience working in cross-functional and international teams
- Entrepreneurial mindset with strong customer and value focus
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Willingness to travel (low frequency)
- Fluent English (additional languages are a plus)

This is your new job

- Work closely with the business team on finance planning & budgeting data preparation & consolidation and conduct regular reviews together with relevant business stakeholders
- Financial process tasks support, incl. Month-End-Closing (MEC), Quarter-End-Closing (QEC) and Year-End-Closing (YEC)
- Financial controlling reporting, incl. forecast planning report, quarterly finance rolling forecast reporting, monthly/quarterly forecast vs. actual variance detailed analysis & reporting on findings
- Collaborate closely with key business stakeholders across Business Groups (BGs), managing R&D project budget and cost tracking, and supporting new project ROI analysis and fulfilment reviews
- Conduct business case validation with project, marketing, and controlling teams, including data-driven comparisons, IRR analysis, investment risk assessment, and presenting insights and recommendations to the management team.
- Support long-term strategic planning, including participation in business strategy discussions and finance data consolidation/reporting
- Support BG key projects in in-house CAPEX investment ROI evaluation, as well as fixed asset management, including budget control, cost tracking, and reporting
- Support Finance projects, particularly cross-BG standardization, reporting automation projects, government subsidy application support (including business case evaluation), and BG internal control process utilization projects.
- Assist with daily finance operations and other ad-hoc finance tasks

This is you

- University degree in Finance, Accounting or Economics, preferably with Accounting/Financial Management Major.
- Min 5 years of relevant working experience in an Accounting or Corporate Finance position in an international corporate environment.
- Experience in a Multinational Company within the semiconductor or related industry is highly preferred
- Fast learner, willing to take challenges and could handle pressure and complete work in timeline
- Skilled in Office tools, PowerPoint, SAP or other ERP platform experience, good excel/data analysis skill is preferred
- Strong communication skills and a collaborative team spirit, particularly in cross-functional and cross-regional environments
- Fluency in English is a must (written and spoken)
- Openness to occasional business travel (10%)

jobs.occupation: Head of T&O Controlling (m/f/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule) - Rechnungswesen und Controlling)
jobs.description:
About the role

As Head of T&O Controlling, you will lead a global team of finance professionals and be responsible for all financial planning, reporting, forecasting, and governance activities across the T&O organization. Acting as a trusted business partner to the COO, CFO, and senior leadership team, you will provide strategic financial insights, drive investment and performance decisions, and ensure robust controls, compliance, and operational excellence across all T&O sites.

This is your new role

- Lead and develop the Global T&O Controlling team (40+FTEs), including performance management, coaching, and capability building.
- Own the delivery of central T&O financial reporting, ensuring timely, accurate and consistent reporting across all T&O Sites.
- Provide executive‑level financial insights, turning data into clear narratives and recommendations for the COO, CFO, and senior leadership.
- Own execution of the T&O planning calendar and governance, driving consistency, accuracy, and alignment across all financial cycles (Budget, RFF, Strategic Plan).
- Lead financial analysis and support strategic projects. Ensuring business cases assess opportunities available across different scenarios and drive effective decision making within the project teams.
- Drive the CAPEX process, ensuring effective and efficient processes and procedures in place to support the business making the right investment decisions, and projects are held accountable for post investment performance.
- Ensure accurate forecasting of Capex and Opex commitments for business planning.
- Ensure effective business controls and standardized processes are in place to cover all T&O cycles, drive compliance with Nexperia SOPs and ensure controls are robust, effective and efficient.
- Serve as a key member of the T&O management team, supporting the COO and Management Team drive improvements in all areas of T&O performance.

This is you

- University degree in Finance, Accounting, Controlling, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field
- Professional qualifications as an MBA, CPA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent are an advantage
- Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in Finance and related Business processes such as Manufacturing, Supply Chain Management etc.
- Proven track record of leading and developing high-performing global teams, driving performance management, talent development, and organizational capability building
- Excellent understanding of financial controls, governance frameworks, compliance requirements, and process standardization, ensuring robust and efficient operating practices across global organizations
- Proven stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships at executive level, challenge constructively, drive change, and support strategic decision-making in a fast-paced environment
- Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken) are essential, with the ability to present complex financial information clearly and confidently to international senior stakeholders; additional languages are considered a plus

Job Description

About the job

As Business Product Manager you will maximize revenue and profitability of an existing family or families of products within a Product Group’s portfolio. You own the Pricing and Go to Market (G2M) strategy for running portfolios.

The role requires profound knowledge and experience in pricing strategies, channel management and negotiation. Furthermore, a strong ability to manage a complex network of internal and external stakeholders, including customers is required.

What you will do

- Drive revenue and profitability of the assigned product segment by being hungry and willing to win in a challenging and dynamic business environment
- Be the business partner for Business Group (BG) Marketing and Global Sales & Marketing (GSM) in the assigned product portfolio (manufacturing strategy, benefits, longevity etc.)
- Develop key customer & channel strategies together with Product Group Head, Business Marketing Managers, Product Marketing Managers and GSM
- Own the pricing tactics and quote policies for all sales channels for Commercial Marketing in alignment with Product Marketing Managers, Business Marketing Managers and in line with overall Product Group target settings
- Build & maintain G2M material
- Competitor analysis: consolidate input from regions about competitor behaviors, especially pricing strategy at Distribution and OEM channel, inputting (to Industrial) for required cost down roadmaps to reach Product Group margin targets
- Forecasting: align with Demand Management in line with forecast process
- Manage pricing strategy, price setting and special offers for business via Distribution partners
- Drive design-in/design-win success through organizing necessary support to BG Marketing and GSM
- Establish and maintain relationships with key customers and partners in alignment with BG Marketing and GSM.

What you will need

- University degree in electrical and electronic engineering or other related discipline
- Min. 5 years’ experience in Product Marketing or Product Management in the Semiconductor industry
- Proven track record of product (lifecycle) management, with strong understanding of market trends and customer needs, preferably with exposure to international customers
- Strong individual accountability, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
- Ability to establish lasting relationships and networks in a complex environment across different levels of hierarchies and various stakeholders in a multiple culture environment
- Direct work experience with Power semiconductors or previous experience in product line is preferred
- Knowledge of key business metrics and strong negotiation skills
- Business fluent in English (written and spoken), any other language is a plus
- Willingness to travel occasionally

jobs.occupation: Financial Analyst (m/w/d) - Controlling Rotation Program (Betriebswirt/in (Fachschule) - Finanzen und Investment/Bachelor Professional in Wirtschaft)
jobs.description:
Job Description

About the role

Build your future with passion: Get engaged with state-of-the-art Technology in one of the leading discrete semiconductor companies globally in a 24 month controlling rotation graduate program.

What you will do

- Gain deep insights and experience of how an international tech company drives its Finance activities. For that, you will agree on several rotations in different departments across the company with your mentor
- Learn about the business by looking from multiple angles at business processes
- Gain exposure to senior management from Day 1
- Work for a global company with opportunities to travel/work abroad
- Take responsibility with perseverance: You are closely incorporated in functional and project tasks and into the daily operational work
- Optimize your performance: Use training opportunities on- and off the job
- Professionalize your out-of-the-box thinking
- Close cooperation: You have a personal mentor who provides support for you throughout the program

What you will need

- Master’s degree in Finance, Controlling or Accounting
- First experience in a similar field is an advantage
- Proficiency with numbers and ability to understand and work with complex concepts and data sets
- Strong attention to detail
- Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written.
- International/intercultural experience gained during studies or internships
- High level of motivation and willingness to learn
- Proactive mindset focused on high quality results combined with out-ofthe-box thinking
- Strong collaborative and team-working skills, structured and solutionoriented working methods

The Transport Execution department is responsible for managing the entire transport coordination of the oversized turbine components from manufacturing plant to project site. The department has an open and informal culture, where teamwork and good communication are the key to our success. You will have the opportunity to work in an exciting industry together with a team of highly motivated colleagues.

Vestas has various possible office locations in Central Europe for this position, with Hamburg being the preferred. We are looking for a motivated person to join our team for the German market for project deliveries, which will have a tremendous growth in the coming years.

Responsibilities:

- Overall ownership of the project transport budget and the operation from worldwide origins up to site, being in close communication with internal and external stakeholders on transport status and optimization on a timely manner
- Full coordination responsibility of deliveries to site including nominated transport providers and other relevant internal and external stakeholders, which requires effectively delivering solutions for changing situations to comply with the project schedule
- Handle thoroughly the project transport spend and identify and develop cost optimizations
- Assessing subcontractor performance, investigate transport quality issues and support problem-solving of deliveries
- Assessment of road surveys and -modifications, storage areas etc. and developing transport strategies in close collaboration with other Vestas’s areas
- Support in planning and coordinating the returns for Vestas owned transport equipment back to the relevant factories worldwide
- Following Vestas processes and standards, including the correct usage of our Transport Management Systems, including close collaboration with our customs department to ensure the proper documentation is provided duly

Qualifications:

- Education within the transport or supply chain management area, freight forwarding or similar with several years of related experience
- Well-developed project management skills and understanding the spending control of projects
- Ideally you have an operational, commercial or technical Freight Forwarding or Heavy Haulage trucking background. Over-sized/project experience to be preferred
- Proficient in written and verbal English and German
- Solid knowledge of ERP systems (preferable SAP) is beneficial as well as work experience in international corporations

Competencies:

- Ability to catch details and focus on the relevant parts of the task
- Pragmatic and solution oriented without letting safety aspects aside
- Confident to take the initiative, bring your work forward, to draw and communicate conclusions
- General understanding of technical transport drawings, lashing plans, stowage plans etc. and other relevant documentation
- Preference to working in a fast-paced environment
- Customer-focused, and ability to maneuver among various stakeholders, with good communication skills and understanding of different cultures
- Team oriented, and international mindset and able to navigate within a complex global company structure

Your benefits – because your contribution counts:

- Start & Perspective: Structured onboarding program and a permanent employment contract with long-term prospects 
- Development & Skills: Varied work in a forward-looking industry and individual opportunities for professional growth
- Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Overtime account, option to work from home up to 8 days per month, 30 days of vacation plus Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve off, and the option for a sabbatical 
- Add-Ons: Business bike, gym allowance, company pension plan, Germany-wide train ticket (Deutschlandticket) 
- Team & Culture: Scandinavian-inspired with flat hierarchies, informal culture, and great team spirit

jobs.occupation: Cyber Services Program and Product Lead (Leiter/in - Projekt-/Programmmanagement)
jobs.description:
As a Cyber Services Product and Program Lead (m/f/d), you will be responsible for shaping Vestas Cyber Security Services.

You will work in Vestas Service business area and manage the commercial portfolio of OT and Cyber Security Services, this is a dual role that combines product and program ownership.

This position sits within Global Service Commercial, under Plant and Energy Solutions Product Development. The responsibility of the department is to define and mature-to-market plant, cyber and digital service offerings for selling long term service agreements and other contractual service offerings within the renewable energy sector. Cyber security is an important strategic initiative that supports Vestas' vision to be a leader in renewable energy solutions and shall ensure long-term profitability and competitiveness of Vestas Service business.

Join us in ensuring resilient cybersecurity solutions in the global renewable energy projects.

Ready to safeguard the energy revolution?

Responsibilities:

As Cyber Services Product and Program Lead you will work closely with global and regional cross-functional teams to lead the roadmap of cyber security services within Vestas' service business. The role will be the Global Service Commercial product lead for bringing ideas to market around Vestas' cyber security offerings.

- Program Management - you oversee the portfolio of our projects in the OT and Cyber Security services area. You are first point of contact on reporting around our initiatives, summarizing development budgets and defining governance in cooperation with other departments. You support strategic work and can manage projects, when needed.
- Service product roadmap - you will be responsible to build a long-term roadmap while ensuring the strategic direction is firm and accepted in close alignment with relevant parts of the business. You will position the services with reference to different market and customer groups, lead competitor and industry analysis, ensure business case development and alignment with relevant functions and integrate commercial and technical elements into cohesive offerings.
- Product Management - you take Cyber Security service product and solutions to market that are scalable, standardized and matured to ensure high market efficiency, risk management optimization and highest possible value contribution. You lead the launch of our solutions and understand what our frontline requires for selling. You can produce relevant commercial documentation, define commercial structures and manage internal product training.
- Requirement management - you understand customer expectations and are skilled in working with Global Experts in gathering requirements, that you will translate towards new services design. On top, you can formulate commercial targets making sure our services can be effectively deployed with customers.You can facilitate alignment across functions when trade-offs are required to deliver effective and scalable solutions.
- Product Accountability - you provide support to the regional sales teams in responding to customer and sales request as a go-to-market lead post-launch.

Qualifications:

- Academic background in Business Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), Operational Technology (OT), Engineering, or a related field.
- Proven experience as a Project Manager within a technology-driven environment.
- Experience working effectively in a matrix organization.
- Ideally, a background in a commercially focused role
- Solid understanding of networking technologies, SCADA systems, and cybersecurity, gained through professional experience is a plus.
- Previous experience in the renewable energy industry is considered a strong advantage.
- Excellent command of English; German language skills are a plus.

Competencies:

- Genuine passion for the renewable energy industry and Cyber Security
- Experience with matrixed organizations and building strong stakeholder relationships
- Ability to navigate leadership and colleagues equally as well as sales and engineering teams
- Proven track record in developing and executing strategies that deliver results
- Ability to handle multiple assignments, passionate and highly persistent
- Solid technological aptitude with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to general audiences, in speaking and writing
- Snr. Leadership communication experience

Your benefits – because your contribution counts!

- Start & Perspective: Structured onboarding program and a permanent employment contract with long-term prospects 
- Development & Skills: Varied work in a forward-looking industry and individual opportunities for professional growth
- Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Overtime account, option to work from home up to 8 days per month, 30 days of vacation plus Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve off, and the option for a sabbatical 
- Add-Ons: Business bike, gym allowance, company pension plan, Germany-wide train ticket (Deutschlandticket) 
- Team & Culture: Scandinavian-inspired with flat hierarchies, informal culture, and great team spirit
- You will join a small and evolving organization, where you are empowered to lead, define, motivate and shape how Vestas and its customers are made fit for future.

Global Offshore Sales is responsible for all sales related activities from early engagement, to bidding and negotiation until hand-over to Construction upon the completed closure of a contract. The wider team consists of a diverse group of motivated employees covering the globe, alongside a team that provides bid management and sales support.

Responsibilties:

- Face the customers throughout the entire sales process

- Bachelor's degree in business administration (or similar), coupled with relevant professional and project management experience, ideally within the wind energy, power plants, infrastructure or the construction industry
- Understanding of the commercial and technical aspects of complex products and ability to translate this knowledge into a contractual context
- Experience with long-term sales processes and will be required to deliver results in a matrix organisation selling large-scale projects
- Experience with Yellow FIDIC Book

To further strengthen our international flight training activities, AutoGyro is looking for a qualified and experienced Gyrocopter Flight Instructor (m/f/d).

In this role, you will be responsible for delivering high quality flight training for gyroplane pilots in both practical and theoretical environments. You will work in accordance with applicable German and international aviation regulations as well as internal standards and contribute to maintaining and developing our global training quality.

The position combines hands on flight instruction with close collaboration across engineering, sales and after sales functions. You will operate in an international environment and represent AutoGyro towards customers and partners in a professional aviation context.

The activity is based on site at our location in Hildesheim, with occasional international assignments.

The role can alternatively be structured as a cooperation with self employed flight instructors (m/f/d) or flight schools. This includes the delivery of training under the AutoGyro framework and alignment with defined standards and procedures.

Become part of our dynamic team and actively contribute to the success of our company. You can expect attractive conditions as well as free lunch every day.

Tasks

- Delivery of flight training for gyroplane pilots in both practical and theoretical environments
- Instruction and supervision of students in accordance with applicable German and international aviation regulations and internal standards
- Execution of check flights, proficiency checks and refresher training
- Customer handover flights and aircraft familiarisation
- Assessment of student performance and documentation of training progress
- Contribution to the continuous development of training concepts and standards in line with international requirements
- Close coordination with engineering, sales and after sales in relation to aircraft and customer requirements
- Representation of AutoGyro towards customers and partners in a professional aviation context

Requirements

- Valid Flight Instructor qualification for gyroplane or a comparable instructor licence with willingness to convert
- Proven flight experience, ideally within ultralight or gyroplane aviation
- Strong instructional capability with a structured and safety oriented approach
- Sound understanding of aviation regulations and operational procedures
- High level of responsibility, reliability and professional judgement
- Confident communication skills in English and German
- Willingness to travel occasionally, including international assignments

Benefits

- Dynamic working environment with the global leader in gyroplane manufacturing.
- Comprehensive onboarding and continuous training opportunities.
- Supportive and international team culture.
- Flexible working hours (flexitime) to support work–life balance.
- Corporate fitness programme (Hansefit).
- Employer contributions to the pension scheme.
- Employee discounts via our corporate benefits platform.
- Regular company events that strengthen team spirit.
- Free daily lunch at our headquarter.
- Overtime compensation and additional paid leave for special occasions.
- Unique aviation experience – including a gyrocopter sightseeing flight.

Are you ready for an exciting career in aviation? Then become part of AutoGyro GmbH.

We are the global market leader in the development, production, and sales of gyroplanes, working with partners in more than 40 countries worldwide. Our headquarters and production facility are located at Hildesheim Airport. With state-of-the-art technologies, a high level of in-house manufacturing, and a clear vision for sustainable aviation, we actively shape the future of flight.

Since our founding in 1999, we have grown continuously and today employ an international team of nearly 100 qualified specialists and engineers. With a global sales network, we consistently pursue our mission: to make the fascination of flying, maximum safety, and the versatile applications of gyroplanes accessible worldwide.

What you will do

Projects:

- Facilitate assigned projects in terms of the given time and cost targets
- Creation of time schedules and cost estimations for budgeting the projects
- Provide support to  end-to-end project execution based on the department’s project management process
- Apply all designated projects processes, starting with project order until handover to the client
- Responsibility for the safety of the construction sites related to the projects on behalf of Nexperia. Project manager will become construction manager
- Close cooperation with the Facility Management operations team to align with the needs and demands of the existing supply systems. Preparation of technical data to be put into the internal tracking software  
- Take account of production requirements while having construction sites

Specialty Gas Installation Systems:

- Responsible for the standardization of specialty gas installations systems
- Update and Revision of the Nexperia Guideline for the Semiconductor-Compliant Installation of High-Purity Gases
- Ensuring the latest state-of-the-art technology is applied under consideration of required quality, safety, 24/7 production requirements and economic reasons
- Maintain and review the test protocol and welding procedures for contractors to ensure appropriate installation
- Owner of the guideline, training to the FM team and continuous exchange with contractors and suppliers

General:

- Main key stakeholders will be the Global FM Manager and Manager Projects within the Real Estate/Facility Management group, as well as the Site Manager and the Production manager of the site Hamburg
- Support of quality, safety, environmental and energy management systems according to the requirements of the standards IATF:16949, OHSAS:18001, ISO:14001 and ISO:5000

What you will need

- Masters degree in process engineering or similar
- Minimum of 3 years of experience, working in a similar role
- Working experience in a comparable field is desirable
- Project management skills by using typical software such as MS Project
- Proficient knowledge of MS Office applications (Excel, Word, Power Point), knowledge of CAD software is desirable
- Quick comprehension of technically complex tasks
- Experience in semiconductor industries or comparable is a plus
- Strong communication skills due to varying requesters and the ability to listen precisely to the required needs
- Structured way of working is required
- Persistence, assertiveness, and determination are mandatory habits to meet the job requirements
- Fluent German and English

application boards with a strong focus on Industrial motor-control and motor-drive applications

that showcase Nexperia’s portfolio. This position is part of our System and Application Team and

plays a critical role in bridging product development and customer requirements by translating

device capabilities into practical, production ready hardware solutions

The role is central to enabling customer adoption and accelerating time-to-market through high

quality design collaterals, hands-on validation and technical support

IHRE HAUPTAUFGABEN

discrete, analog, and power IC solutions

• Create schematics, perform component selection, and collaborate on PCB layout to optimize

performance, efficiency, cost, thermal behavior, and reliability

• Perform comprehensive electrical, thermal, and system-level validation, including efficiency

analysis, switching characterization, transient response testing, thermal profiling, and

EMI/EMC pre-compliance evaluation and troubleshooting

• Provide application-focused technical support to customers and sales teams by

troubleshooting designs, supporting design-in activities, participating in customer

engagements, and representing Nexperia at workshops, conferences, and exhibitions

• Create and maintain high-quality technical collateral such as application notes, design guides,

simulation models, user manuals, and web-based application content
